scope: Local macOS Apple Silicon / Colima Rosetta / Linux amd64 Mesa. Numeric records only; assets remain untracked.

allAllRepeat.method: Independent full CLI jobs compared to the preceding full baseline. This is all/all, not every ID in a separate single-item process. The CLI snapshots were taken before the final API-lifecycle edits; renderer bytes were unchanged.

rawFinalBuild.method: Final core/CLI snapshots; each PNG and present mcmeta compared byte-for-byte to its official client JAR.

benchmark.memorySample: kernel cumulative high-water marks after the final icon, before shutdown
benchmark.coldScope: Empty application asset cache; Docker VM/image already prepared, OS page cache not flushed.

limitations: All-ID single/all equivalence is still covered by representative IDs rather than separate processes for every ID.
Game reference imagery, exact game color space and missing model/texture detection remain incomplete.
Windows/Linux hosts, Docker Desktop, native backends and ARM64 images remain untested.
SIGKILL cleanup was observed on a healthy Docker daemon after handshake; immediate cleanup under a daemon/pipe failure is not guaranteed.
Memory high-water marks are sampled after the final icon before shutdown; timings include the bounded sampling call.
The benchmark covers 1.21.4 with one cold and two warm runs; it is not a cross-version or cross-machine performance guarantee.

The seven legacy versions were fully revalidated after the texture-manager fix. The preceding 51-version repetition and benchmark used the earlier worker; unchanged adapters were not re-run with the new aggregate JAR hash.
